dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Wow! Look at this stage you've built... it's perfect!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Um... Heh, uh... I—I know a few dance moves, so... would you mind if I tested them out here?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: ...Really? You actually wanna watch? That's great! I won't disappoint! ...At least, I hope I won't...
